messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By what date is the Commission required to present the second specific report, under Article 53(3), evaluating Article 6(4) and (5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Entro quale data la Commissione è tenuta a presentare la seconda relazione specifica, ai sensi dell'articolo 53, paragrafo 3, che valuta l'articolo 6, paragrafi 4 e 5, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230?
